The famous ship that sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg is the RMS Titanic.

Regarding the effectiveness of the encryption methods mentioned in the paragraph: The text describes the implementation of AES-256 bit encryption. AES-256 is widely considered highly effective and secure. It uses a 256-bit key, which provides a massive key space that makes brute-force attacks computationally infeasible with current technology. Therefore, the assessment that it is "very secure" and "nearly impervious to brute-force attacks" is accurate. However, it is important to note that while strong encryption protects data at rest or in transit, overall security also depends on proper key management, implementation practices, and protection against other types of cyber threats (such as social engineering or software vulnerabilities).
